Name: No Poverty By Disconnect
Author: bantambree
Description:
The mod of course is only relevant in separate cash multiplayer games.

How it works:
When players go to sleep, this mod checks if there are any disconnected players which put items in their shipping bin. If there are any, those players receive the money they would have made (right at that point of time). So when they reconnect the next day, they will already have their earnings.

This [b]has to be used by the host[/b] of the server, and (preferably, see bugs below) [b]only the host[/b]. I will fix the issues to allow for use on all clients without issues in the near future, but meanwhile, just make sure to make the host run the mod. :)


Possible Bugs:
It might cause multiple income in shared economy mp games (going to test this tomorrow).
If multiple players have this mod running, it might even in separate economy games cause multiple incomes for the disconnected player.

Manifest.Name: NoPovertyByDisconnect
Manifest.Description: Grants disconnected players income for the items in their shipping bin.
